contexts.text: The Perizzite = falsity from evil. Illustrated.
The Girgashite and the Jebusite = falsities from evils.
Vine of Sodom = falsity from evil.
Falsity from evil raging against good. Signified.
The falsity from evil that is within the Church, is especially the falsity which favours evils of life. Example(s).
Gomorrah = the falsity which is from the evil of the love of self...
The power of falsity from evil. Signified.
The falsity which is from hereditary evil.
They dipped the coat in the blood = that they defiled with falsities from evils.
The affection of evil from the falsity of evil. Signified.
Evil from the falsity of evil. Defined.
Er... evil in the eyes of Jehovah = that he was in the falsity of evil.
Evil wild beasts = falsities from evils... destroying the Church.
Truths defiled by falsities from evil. Signified.
Night = falsity from evil; for they who are in falsity from evil are in the obscurity of night.
Wine, in the opposite sense, = falsity from evil. Illustrated. AC 8481:end.
The king of the north = falsities from evil.
Under Egypt, see this reference. AC 7576. AC 7732. AC 7980. AC 8154. AC 8161. etc.
The light of the world sparkles with those who are in falsity from evil...
The water as a flood which the dragon cast out = falsities from evil, and the reasonings thence derived...
The fifth degree (of vastation) is, that they were in falsities from evils, by which all truth was destroyed: these are signified by the baneful flying things. AC 7442. AC 7442:2, Explained.
Hail = falsities from evil destroying the truths and goods of faith. AC 7574. AC 7577.

They then seize on falsities which agree with the evils of their cupidities; for falsities which agree with the cupidities of evil exist interiorly with those who live evilly... In the other life, when externals are taken away... the falsities break forth, both those which they had thought in the world, and those which they had not manifestly thought; for they burst forth from the evils which had been of their life; for the falsities are nothing but evils reasoning, and supporting themselves.
The locusts = falsity from evil in the extremes.
See Darkness. AC 7712. AC 8197:2. AC 8211. HH 553:end. HH 586.
There is now described the state of the infesters in mere falsity from evil... The more the infernals are in falsities from evil, the more they are averse to truth... Signified.
A graven image = the falsity of evil.
Falsities from evils are signified by the waters which overwhelmed the Egyptians. AC 8223.
The falsities from evils of those who had been of the Spiritual Church... appear as waters; but the falsities from evils of those who had been of the Celestial Church, as mists.
Under Pharaoh, see this reference. AC 8159.
See Faith alone.
The dominion of power where there is the Hell of falsity from evil. Signified.
To divide the Red Sea = to dissipate the falsities from evil which are in that Hell.
An endeavour to inflict violence by an influx of falsity from evil. Signified.
Protection lest the falsity of evil should flow into the will. Signified.
The condensation of falsity from evil on the one hand. Signified.
The return of the falsities from evil upon themselves. Signified. AC 8334.
The redounding of falsities from evil to them from the presence of the Lord. Signified.
Casting into Hell is nothing but a being crowded upon by the mere falsities which are from evil in which they had been in the world... AC 8334.
Falsity from evil is of such a nature, that it falls down like a heavy body...
Abysses = the Hells relatively to falsities from evils.
That mere falsities from the evil of the cupidities of the love of self could not possibly emerge. Signified, Explained.
The people heard = all who are in falsity from evil everywhere.
A people from the land of the north = those who are in falsities from evil.
The word for mighty ones, here, is predicated of those who are in truth from good; and, in the opposite sense, of those who are in falsity from evil.
For, by evil of life, men become forms of falsities from evil.
The falsity of evil which is in good from proprium, is compared to a worm, because... it gnaws, and thus torments.
A stone of lead = falsity of evil closing up.
Under Amalek, see this reference. AC 8593, etc.
A diminution of power with those who are in falsity from interior evil. Signified.
The Lord's continual war and protection against those who are in the falsity of interior evil. Signified.
Gain, in general, = all falsity from evil which perverts the judgments of the mind.
Good is not conjoined with truths, until those truths have been purified from the falsities which are from evil.
In the other life, they who are in falsities from evil are encompassed with a cloud dense and black according to the quality and quantity of the falsities.
Prolification of the falsity from evil thence. Signified.
The falsity by which evil is affirmed...
The sides of the earth = where falsities from evil break forth.
To smite with the fist of wickedness = with full force by falsities from evil.
Lions = falsities from evil in their power.
The taking away of good or truth through falsity from evil... Signified.
Hell = falsity from evil, because it reigns there.
Blood... = truth Divine destroyed through falsities from evil. Illustrated.
What is done from both (will and understanding), is done from the falsity which is from evil...
A river of sulphur = falsities from the evils of the loves of self and of the world.
Truths of doctrine from the Word, by which there is protection from the falsities of evil. Signified.
Falsity of evil in the Intellectual is like smoke...
A witch = those with whom anything of the Church is conjoined with the falsities of the evil of the love of self. Explained.
The worship of falsities from evil. Signified.
Falsities from evil are evils in form... AC 9331:2.
The extirpation of falsities from evil. Signified.
Falsities in which there is evil are like the trees which bear evil fruit, which are to be rooted up and cast into the fire.
Keep thee far from the word of a lie = aversion for falsity from evil.
Under Ferment, see this reference. AC 9992:2.
His Providence and protection from the falsities of evil. Signified.
Turning away from Him through falsities from evil. Signified.
See Enemy. AC 9330. AE 316:11. etc.
That falsities from evil are not to be worshipped. Signified.
Falsities of evil are worshipped, when worship is performed according to doctrine which is forged from falsified truths and adulterated goods.
It follows that falsity from evil has no power at all. AC 10182:5. HH 539.

In the other life, they who are in falsities from evil at first fight against those who are in truths from good... The latter are thus confirmed against falsities; and they who are in falsities from evil are confirmed in falsities, and thus devastate themselves; for, there, falsities are removed from those who are in good; and truths are removed from those who are in falsities from evil; and thus they who are in truths from good are elevated into Heaven, and they who are in falsities from evil sink down into Hell... Signified.
I will send the hornet before thee = the dread of those who are in falsities of evil.
The flight of falsities from evils. Signified.
A lioness = falsity from evil perverting the truths of the Church.
The pit in which he was taken by the nations = the falsity of evil.

King and princes, and also silver and gold = falsities from evil; for the things which are from proprium are evil, and consequently false, although outwardly they appear to be truths, because they have been taken from the sense of the letter of the Word.
They who apply the external sense of the Word to confirm falsities from the evils of the love of self and of the world, Signified.
Under Bittern, see this reference.
The fiery smoke is falsity from evils of concupiscences.
The terror by night = falsities of evil from Hell.
The falsities with those who are in evil are falsities of evil.
Around those who are in falsities from evil there appear marshes, privies, and many monstrosities.
(With such) Hell flows in with falsities from evil...
Study from proprium is nothing but falsity from evil...
Hence, they who love evil, think falsity from the evil of the love...
Holy = devoid of falsity of evil.
It is said falsity of evil, because there exists falsity without evil...
To grind to powder = the infernal falsity thence.
Truth from good fighting against falsity from evil. Signified.
Son's sons = falsities from evils in a long series.
Under Evil, see this reference.
Thou shalt break their statues = that the falsities of evil are to be dissipated.
To commit whoredom after the gods of the nations = to be conjoined with falsities of evil.
The enticement, reception, and appropriation of falsity from evil. Signified.
(In Hell) they who are in falsities of evil dwell from their south to their north.
(I have perceived) the sphere of the falsity from evil flowing forth from Hell. Described.
The smoke therefrom = falsity from evil.

Falsity not of evil can be conjoined with good, but not falsity of evil; for falsity not of evil is falsity in the understanding and not in the will; and falsity of evil is falsity in the understanding from evil in the will.
That even those in falsities (from evil) will see the Lord. Signified. AE 38.
A great sword = the destruction of truth through falsities of evil.
That they have purified their (general truths) from falsities of evil by means of truths. Signified.
That henceforward they will not have concupiscences to... falsity of evil. Signified.
Evil confirmed in the understanding is falsity of evil; hence the falsity of evil is evil in its form.

Falsities from evils exist with those who do not account evils to be sins; and still more with those who, by reasonings from the natural man, and above all from the Word, confirm with themselves that evils are not sins: the confirmations themselves are falsities from evils; and are called falsities of evil.
Falsities of the concupiscences of the natural man springing from their evil loves. Signified.
See Faith alone.
For 1600 furlongs = mere falsities of evil.
A lie, here, = falsities of evil, which in themselves are evils; thus falsities confirming evil, which are the same as the evils confirmed.
See Thorn.
Because truths cannot be together with falsities of evil... and therefore, when falsities from evil reign, communication with Heaven is taken away...
The seven unclean Spirits = all falsities of evil...
That when the love of self occupies the natural man, it turns everything scientific therein into falsity of evil. Signified.
The name of the star is wormwood = truth mixed with falsity of evil. AE 520:2, Explained.
Falsities of evil... innumerable, conspiring against the truths of good. Signified.
That truths with them are turned into falsities from evil. Signified.

The reason falsities from evil have power, which is signified by the ten horns of the dragon, is that falsities from evil have power over those who are in falsities from evil... And these falsities from evil can be expelled from a man only little by little... for they constitute his life; and as the state of man is such at the end of the Church, the falsities of evil have power; although they have no power whatever against truth from good. By His Divine truth, the Lord could at once cast out the falsities of evil which are with man, but this would at once cast the man into Hell...
War in Heaven = combat of falsity against truth, and of truth against falsity... falsity, here, means falsity from evil, and truth means truth from good.
All those are in falsity of evil who have thought nothing about Heaven and the Lord in their life, but only about themselves and the world. Explained.
The production of falsity from evil. Explained. AE 920:4. AE 922. Signified.
That from this they are in falsities of evil. Signified.
The reason falsified truth is falsity of evil, is that evil falsifies truth.
In proportion as he can see truth, falsities of evil do not stand in the way...
But falsities from evil do not enter... in the first age of man...
